verdict.rationale: First-party Workers docs explicitly state you can 'schedule cron jobs, run durable Workflows, and integrate with Queues'. Workflows chain multiple steps, retry failed tasks automatically, persist state for minutes to weeks and can pause for external events or approvals. The Agents SDK also lists built-in scheduling. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of cron trigger configuration (syntax, limits, management via Wrangler or the dashboard), and independent or hands-on corroboration of recurring scheduling in practice.
